correctness.rationale: Rank-two order-preserving transformations are parametrized by (a;b,c), 1<=a<n, 1<=b<c<=n. A pair (a;b,c),(d;e,h) consists of mutual inverses precisely when e<=a<h and b<=d<c. The explicit map exchanging a<b with c<=a and fixing b<=a<c meets these inequalities and is involutive. At rank n-1 each transformation is uniquely determined by the adjacent doubled kernel block {d,d+1} and absent image value m. Mutual inverse conditions for [d;m] and [e;k] are k∈{d,d+1} and m∈{e,e+1}; the stated m<d, m=d or d+1, m>d+1 branches exchange and meet these criteria. Fixed maps are exactly the idempotents. Enumerating a(n-a) rank-two idempotents gives C(n+1,3), and opposite-branch triples give C(n,3) two-cycles; corank-one gives 2(n-1), C(n-1,2). Any fixed point of an inverse involution satisfies f³=f; isotone maps induce increasing involutive permutations on im(f), necessarily identity, so fixed maps must be idempotent. Independent enumeration for all 4<=n<=19 checked τ², the transversal conditions, and exact cycle counts, e.g. n=19 rank-two 1140 fixed among 3078; corank-one 36 fixed among 342.
residual_risks: Case branches are sensitive to inverse composition convention, but verified via symmetric mutual inverse equations and independent enumeration.
The theorem intentionally does not classify intermediate Green strata.

value.rationale: Inverse matchings and involutive inverses are substantive structural questions in regular transformation semigroups, not mere labeling. The explicit two extreme Green-stratum involutions work for every n, attain the theoretically maximal number of fixed idempotents, and enumerate all two-cycles. The middle-stratum parity obstruction for O_5,D_3 motivates focusing on these exceptional extremes. Existing weaker permutation matchings do not give those properties or counts.
residual_risks: The construction does not settle global involution existence; do not imply an arbitrary Green-stratum classification.

final_claim: For n>=4, each of the rank-two and rank-(n-1) Green strata of the isotone full transformation monoid O_n admits the explicit piecewise involutive mutual-inverse matching τ given in frozen RESULT.md, fixing exactly all idempotents. At rank 2 fixed points C(n+1,3) and two-cycles C(n,3); at corank 1 fixed points 2(n-1) and two-cycles C(n-1,2).
limitations: Only D2 and D_(n-1) of order-preserving transformations, n>=4; other ranks may fail by parity.
Does not supply a globally defined inverse matching on the entire monoid or orientation-preserving transformations.
